Thank you, @sandymridul @vintananda for showing us all how resilience and solidarity is at the heart of the #MeToo movement. Sorry you’ll were subject to such harassment&criminal behaviour.
TY for using your platforms to challenge unchecked abuse. You two are pillars of strength.

I have addressed many legal questions that survivors may have when seeking access to redressal agencies.
For survivors that need any additional support, pls reach out to @SheSaysIndia (we do not charge for any of our services).
#MeToo
